result.title: MVAgent: Per-Video Agents under Global Coordination for Multi-Video Understanding
result.summary: Multi-video understanding requires systems to combine evidence from different videos for cross-video reasoning. Answering such questions involves two kinds of decisions. Observation decisions must adapt to each video's content, whereas cross-video judgments require relating evidence from different videos based on the question. Most existing agents make both kinds of decisions in one controller, whose context accumulates observations from every video. We separate them in MVAgent, a training-free Multi-Video Understanding Agent framework with one LocalAgent per video. Each LocalAgent plans observations of its own video and keeps a private observation history. A GlobalAgent coordinates cross-video reasoning by instructing the LocalAgents and combining their reports with joint observation. We evaluate MVAgent on CVBench, MVU-Eval, and CrossVid, using three Qwen3.5 models of different sizes and GPT-6-sol. With Qwen3.5, our framework improves aggregate benchmark scores by 5.1 points on average over Single-pass inference with the same model and by 5.0 points over the strongest prior agent using the same model. With GPT-6-sol, the average gain over Single-pass inference with the same model is 4.3 points. On the same hardware, MVAgent also runs 1.8-2.7 times faster than prior agents of comparable size.

AI.brief_summary: 提出免训练的 MVAgent 框架，为每个视频配置一个负责本视频观测规划与私有历史记录的 LocalAgent，再由 GlobalAgent 指令各 LocalAgent 并将报告与联合观测结合，完成跨视频推理；在 CVBench、MVU-Eval、CrossVid 上以多种 Qwen3.5 与 GPT-6-sol 验证其准确率与速度收益。
AI.relevance_reason: 将观测决策与跨视频判断分离，并以私有观测历史约束证据，可为 LVR 中「何时看、看什么、如何筛选视觉证据并决定停止」的 LOOK/STOP 分工提供参照，但其推理仍以文本报告为中介，未涉及 latent 状态，具体成本与停止机制需核查。
